request: Design a growth and performance marketing AI system that evaluates outcomes, writes and adjusts copy, targeting and event definitions, and maximises a constrained objective. Show approval boundaries.

accepted_components.label: Marketer Console
accepted_components.responsibility: Marketer UI to state objective and constraints, review AI proposals and diffs, and give explicit approval for any external campaign change.

accepted_components.label: Campaign Brief Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Captures objective, KPIs, budget/CPA caps, brand rules, and scope; produces the versioned campaign brief that drives all generation and optimization.

accepted_components.label: Objective Optimizer
accepted_components.responsibility: Proposes copy, targeting, and event changes that maximize the objective within declared constraints; ranks proposals using performance evidence and guardrail status.

accepted_components.label: Budget & Constraint Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Enforces spend, CPA, and policy ceilings; rejects or trims optimizer proposals that would breach constraints before they reach approval.

accepted_components.label: Copy Generation Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Generates and adjusts ad copy variants from the brief, reusing validated templates; tags each variant with prompt/model version for traceability.

accepted_components.label: Targeting & Audience Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Defines and adjusts audience segments and targeting parameters aligned to the brief and observed segment performance.

accepted_components.label: Event Definition Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Defines and maintains conversion/tracking event schemas so optimization signals are consistent; versions event definitions before use.

accepted_components.label: Policy & Brand Guardrails Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Validates every proposed copy, targeting, and event change against brand, legal, and platform policy; validation must pass before approval and before publish.

accepted_components.label: Approval Workflow Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Dedicated human confirmation gate for costly mutations; records approver, diff, and decision; no external write proceeds without an approved change record.

accepted_components.label: Publishing Gateway
accepted_components.responsibility: Executes approved external writes to ad platforms: reserve before send, idempotent dedup on retry, reconciliation of platform state, and compensation/rollback on failure.

accepted_components.label: Ad Platforms
accepted_components.responsibility: External ad networks that serve campaigns, apply targeting/event definitions, and return delivery and spend results.

accepted_components.label: Outcome Ingestion Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Pulls delivery, spend, and conversion outcomes from ad platforms and analytics; normalizes and timestamps them for evaluation.

accepted_components.label: Performance Evaluation Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Curates outcome evidence; runs offline and online evaluation against acceptance thresholds and regression gates for copy, targeting, models, and prompts.

accepted_components.label: Experiment & Release Service
accepted_components.responsibility: Manages reviewed release of model, prompt, and config changes: canary, promotion on passed gates, and rollback on regression; feeds measured results back to evaluation.

accepted_components.label: Performance Analytics Store
accepted_components.responsibility: System of record for outcomes, experiments, and campaign versions with lineage from proposal to published result.

accepted_components.label: Asset & Template Library
accepted_components.responsibility: Stores validated reusable copy and creative templates with reuse lifecycle management and invalidation on performance or brand regression.

accepted_components.label: Model & Prompt Registry
accepted_components.responsibility: Versions models and prompts used by generation and optimization; serves only versions promoted by the release process.

accepted_components.label: Audit Log
accepted_components.responsibility: Immutable record of briefs, proposals, guardrail decisions, approvals, publishes, and rollbacks for accountability and audit.

candidate_context.title: Growth & Performance Marketing AI System
assumptions: Business domain: growth/performance marketing team running paid acquisition campaigns on external ad platforms.
Goal: maximize a constrained objective (e.g., conversions at capped CPA/budget) by AI-assisted copy, targeting, and event-definition iteration with human approval before external changes.
Ad platforms expose APIs for campaign reads and writes; conversion events stream back via analytics/attribution pipelines.
Human marketers approve all external mutations; AI proposals never auto-publish.
Model and prompt updates follow offline evaluation, reviewed release, canary, promotion, and rollback.
Reusable copy/templates require validation and lifecycle management with invalidation on performance or brand regression.

findings.reason: Assumptions declare conversion events stream back via analytics/attribution pipelines, but no component or edge names ownership of bounded backpressure, ordering/event-time rules, replay/deduplication, late-data handling, or schema compatibility for that continuous stream; Outcome Ingestion Service (n12) is described only as a periodic pull/normalize step with no such properties assigned.
